steps.milestone: Revised root recovery after numerical failures
steps.outcome: Floating-point root methods failed on large polynomial coefficients.
steps.evidence_quote: polyroots isn't converging on high-degree big-int polynomials.

steps.milestone: Recovered the private factor and decrypted the challenge
